name: Ollama
description: Get up and running with Llama 3, Mistral, DeepSeek, and other large language models locally with a single command.

name: llama.cpp
description: Port of LLM inference in pure C/C++ with zero dependencies; powers most local LLM tools and defines the GGUF format.

name: Kobold.cpp
description: Single-file, zero-dependency executable for local LLM inference, text generation, and roleplay with built-in web UI.

name: LocalAI
description: Drop-in REST API replacement for OpenAI APIs supporting local text generation, voice (TTS/Whisper), and image generation.
hardware_reqs: CPU, CUDA, Metal, ROCm, Intel GPU

name: vLLM
description: High-throughput and memory-efficient LLM serving engine using PagedAttention, continuous batching, and chunked prefill.
hardware_reqs: NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA), AMD (ROCm), AWS Neuron, CPU

name: SGLang
description: High-performance serving framework for large language models and multi-modal models with RadixAttention for fast prefix caching.

name: ExLlamaV3
description: Optimized quantization and inference library for running LLMs locally on modern consumer GPUs, using the new EXL3 quant format; successor to the now-archived ExLlamaV2.

name: LM Studio
description: Discover, download, and run local LLMs with an intuitive chat interface and local OpenAI-compatible REST server.

name: Jan
description: Open-source, offline-first ChatGPT alternative running 100% locally on your device with multi-engine backend.

name: GPT4All
description: Nomic AI desktop app for running open LLMs privately on everyday hardware, with local document chat over your own files.

name: Open WebUI
description: Feature-rich, self-hosted AI interface for Ollama, vLLM, and OpenAI-compatible APIs with RAG, web search, and voice.

name: TextGen (oobabooga)
description: Open-source desktop app and Gradio web UI for local LLMs with text, vision, and tool-calling support, plus an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API; renamed from text-generation-webui in 2026.

name: AnythingLLM
description: All-in-one desktop and Docker AI app combining RAG, no-code AI agents, and multi-model, multi-user chat over local or remote LLMs.
hardware_reqs: CPU; NVIDIA/Apple Silicon GPU optional for local embeddings/LLM

name: Tabby
description: Self-hosted AI coding assistant offering an open-source alternative to GitHub Copilot with IDE extensions and model serving.
hardware_reqs: NVIDIA CUDA GPU, Apple Silicon, CPU

name: OpenHands
description: Self-hosted autonomous AI software engineer that plans, edits, and runs code in a sandboxed Docker environment via CLI or web GUI; keeps your code on your own machine.
hardware_reqs: CPU (Docker); GPU only if self-hosting the LLM

name: Pi
description: Minimalist, modular terminal-first AI coding agent harness providing read/write/edit/bash primitives, TypeScript extension system, and multi-model switching.

name: Codebuff
description: Open-source terminal-first AI coding agent harness that coordinates specialized sub-agents (file explorer, planner, editor, reviewer) for complex multi-file engineering.

name: Plandex
description: Terminal AI agent harness built for complex multi-file development with 2M+ token context indexing, branch-based plan sandboxes, and cumulative diff reviews.

name: SWE-agent
description: Princeton open-source agent harness turning LLMs into autonomous software engineers to solve real GitHub issues via specialized Agent-Computer Interfaces (ACI).

name: Roo Code
description: Open-source autonomous coding agent harness for VS Code with custom modes (Architect, Code, Ask, Debug), MCP server integration, and sub-agent handoffs.

name: LocalAGI
description: Self-hostable AI agent platform and drop-in replacement for OpenAI Responses API, pairing with LocalAI for fully offline agent orchestration on consumer hardware.

name: Goose
description: Extensible open-source autonomous developer agent harness from Block & Linux Foundation AAIF with tool orchestration, CLI automation, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

name: Unsloth
description: Fast, memory-efficient LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning library with hand-written Triton kernels; ships Unsloth Studio, a local no-code UI for training and exporting models.
hardware_reqs: NVIDIA CUDA GPU (consumer cards from ~8GB VRAM)

name: Text Embeddings Inference
description: Hugging Face high-performance embedding and reranking server with an OpenAI-compatible API, supporting BGE, E5, GTE, Qwen, and Gemma embedding models fully offline.

name: Qwen 2.5 / 3.8
description: Alibaba flagship open-weight LLM family (0.5B to 72B) featuring 128k context, leading reasoning, multilingual support, and open Apache 2.0 license.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder
description: Alibaba specialized open coding models (0.5B to 32B) trained on 5.5T code tokens, rivaling GPT-4o in code generation, refactoring, and bug fixing.

name: GLM-4 / GLM-Edge
description: Zhipu AI and Tsinghua open-weight bilingual foundation models (GLM-4-9B, GLM-Edge on-device) supporting 128k context and function calling.

name: DeepSeek-R1 / V3
description: DeepSeek open-weight reasoning (R1) and general MoE (V3) models with open distilled models (1.5B to 70B on Qwen/Llama) for local reasoning runs.

name: Microsoft Phi-4 / Phi-3.5
description: Microsoft high-efficiency small language models (Phi-4 14B, Phi-3.5 mini/vision/MoE) achieving state-of-the-art reasoning via synthetic training data.

name: Qwen2-VL
description: State-of-the-art open vision-language model understanding images at any resolution, multi-page PDFs, and 20+ minute videos with visual grounding.

name: Florence-2
description: Microsoft lightweight vision foundation model handling captioning, detailed object detection, visual grounding, segmentation, and OCR in 230M-770M params.

name: InternVL 2.5
description: OpenGVLab premier open-source multimodal model family (1B to 78B) with strong visual perception, document understanding, and math OCR.

name: MiniCPM-V
description: OpenBMB efficient multimodal model (2.6-8B) with high-density OCR and high-res image understanding designed to run smoothly on edge devices and laptops.

name: ComfyUI
description: Node-based graph interface for running Stable Diffusion, SDXL, SD3.5, and Flux image/video diffusion models entirely on local hardware.

name: SD WebUI (AUTOMATIC1111)
description: The definitive browser interface for Stable Diffusion and SDXL with inpainting, Outpainting, ControlNet, LoRA, and massive extension ecosystem.
hardware_reqs: NVIDIA GPU (4GB+ VRAM), Apple Silicon, AMD

name: Fooocus
description: Image generation app combining Stable Diffusion XL / Flux quality with Midjourney prompt simplicity, automatic styling, and offline local generation.

name: InvokeAI
description: Professional creative engine for generative image synthesis with an infinite canvas, node workflows, model management, and commercial support.

name: DiffusionBee
description: Zero-setup, one-click native macOS application for running Stable Diffusion and Flux locally on Apple Silicon without terminal commands.

name: CogVideoX
description: THUDM / Zhipu AI open-source text-to-video diffusion transformer model producing smooth 3D video clips locally using Diffusers or ComfyUI.

name: Whisper.cpp
description: High-performance C/C++ port of OpenAI Whisper automatic speech recognition model with CoreML / Metal / CUDA acceleration and zero dependencies.

name: SenseVoice / FunASR
description: Alibaba open speech foundation model offering 5x faster transcription than Whisper, rich emotion recognition, and audio event detection (laughter, applause).

name: Kokoro TTS
description: Ultra-compact 82M parameter text-to-speech model generating expressive, natural human voice locally with real-time speed on CPU and edge devices.

name: Piper
description: Fast, local neural text-to-speech system optimized for offline devices and Raspberry Pi, with voices in dozens of languages.
hardware_reqs: Raspberry Pi, CPU, Mobile, Low-spec systems

name: lm-evaluation-harness
description: Standard framework for few-shot evaluation of language models across 60+ benchmarks (MMLU, GSM8K, ARC, HumanEval), powers Open LLM Leaderboard.
hardware_reqs: CPU / GPU (supports HF, vLLM, SGLang, and APIs)

name: SWE-bench
description: Benchmark and evaluation harness testing autonomous software engineering agents against real-world GitHub issues in Docker sandboxes.

name: Inspect AI
description: Open-source evaluation framework from the UK AI Safety Institute for LLM capability evaluations, tool-use protocols, and agent sandboxing.
hardware_reqs: CPU (runs against local models via Ollama/vLLM or APIs)

name: Promptfoo
description: CLI and CI/CD test harness for testing LLM outputs, prompt engineering, security red-teaming, RAG assertions, and regression suites.

name: DeepEval
description: Production unit testing framework for LLMs (Pytest for AI) covering hallucination detection, answer relevancy, G-Eval, and RAG metrics.
hardware_reqs: CPU (Python package, runs locally or via CI)

name: Ragas
description: Evaluation harness specifically designed for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, measuring faithfulness, context recall and precision.

name: Lighteval
description: Hugging Face's lightweight, flexible evaluation toolkit for testing LLMs across multi-turn chat, math, reasoning, and custom evaluation suites.
hardware_reqs: CPU / GPU (integrates with Hugging Face transformers, TGI, and vLLM)

name: TokenSpeed
description: LLM inference engine separating a C++ control-plane state machine from a Python execution plane, targeting agentic workloads at TensorRT-LLM-class latency with vLLM-like usability.

name: Atomic Chat
description: Cross-platform desktop and mobile app for running open-weight LLMs 100% offline with a Hugging Face model browser and a local OpenAI-compatible server; began as a fork of Jan and has since diverged into its own engine and roadmap.
hardware_reqs: macOS 13.6+, Windows 10/11 x64, Linux; Apple Silicon, CPU, or GPU (CUDA/Vulkan)

name: LocalScore
description: Mozilla Builders open-source benchmark CLI (built on llamafile) that measures local LLM throughput and latency on your specific hardware and submits results to a public leaderboard.
hardware_reqs: Any hardware -- CPU, Apple Silicon (Metal), NVIDIA (CUDA), AMD (ROCm)

name: NeuTTS Air
description: 748M-parameter on-device text-to-speech model with instant 3-second voice cloning that runs in real time on CPU alone, with GGUF quantization for laptops and Raspberry Pi.
hardware_reqs: CPU (laptops, Raspberry Pi, mobile); optional NVIDIA/AMD/Apple GPU for higher throughput
